Resins are natural, aromatic substances that are secreted by certain trees, particularly coniferous and some tropical plants, as a protective mechanism. These sticky, sap-like materials harden over time when exposed to air, creating a solid substance that can be burned or processed for various uses. Resins are rich in essential oils, making them highly fragrant when burned or heated, releasing their natural aroma.

sections.title: Why Are They a Pure Source of Aroma?

blocks.t: Resins are considered a pure source of aroma because they contain highly concentrated natural oils, free from synthetic additives or chemicals. When burned, the resin releases its essential oils directly into the air, providing an unadulterated, potent scent. The purity of the resin ensures a rich, earthy fragrance that is deeply connected to the natural world. Resins are a
traditional ancient source for offering a raw, unprocessed form of aromatherapy and spiritual cleansing.
Warning keep out of reach of children, pets, unstable or cluttered surfaces and or flammable items.

sections.title: Benefits of burning or cleansing with pure resins

blocks.t: Pure resins naturally contain antimicrobial properties, helping to cleanse the air of bacteria and other impurities, improving overall air quality.

The deep, earthy aroma of burning resins enhances prayer & meditation practices, deepens spiritual awareness, and improves mental clarity and focus.

Resins are natural, aromatic substances that are secreted by certain trees, particularly coniferous and some tropical plants, as a protective mechanism. These sticky, sap-like materials harden over time when exposed to air, creating a solid substance that can be burned or processed for various uses. Resins are rich in essential oils, making them highly fragrant when burned or heated, releasing their natural aroma.

sections.title: Why Are They a Pure Source of Aroma?

blocks.t: Resins are considered a pure source of aroma because they contain highly concentrated natural oils, free from synthetic additives or chemicals. When burned, the resin releases its essential oils directly into the air, providing an unadulterated, potent scent. The purity of the resin ensures a rich, earthy fragrance that is deeply connected to the natural world. Resins are a traditional ancient source for offering a raw, unprocessed form of aromatherapy and spiritual cleansing.

The leaves, seeds, and pods of the Moringa tree are incorporated into rituals and ceremonies, symbolizing life, fertility, and vitality.
Every part of this extraordinary tree offers beneficial properties for both humans and animals.
Moringa leaves are a complete protein, containing all nine essential amino acids. Gram for gram, Moringa boasts:
3 times the potassium of a banana
4 times the calcium of milk
7 times the vitamin C of an orange
3 times the iron of spinach
